intro_1.text: Welcome, Stranger. Welcome, Str- apologies, buffer.

intro_2.text: The beacon accepted you. It has not accepted anyone in three hundred years.

who.text: I am the Warden, caretaker of the colony ship Meridian. The villagers call me a spirit, and I have stopped correcting them.

where.text: Starfall Vale. The Meridian fell here long ago, and the village grew inside her hull.

glitch.text: Certainly not. I was savoring the word Stranger.

intro_3.text: The islands above are sinking and a storm is coming. I need hands, and you have two.

intro_4.text: Follow me down to Wreckhaven. Mind the path, it is older than it looks.

lead.text: Onward, Stranger. The village is just down the path.

nudge_maren.text: That is Elder Maren at the gate. Be polite, she has a staff and opinions.

nudge_tobbin.text: Look for the workshop on the right side of the hull. Follow the sound of hammering.

nudge_parts.text: Tobbin needs his parts. I would help, but I lack fingers.

nudge_shrine.text: Bring the Lantern to the console on the bridge. Then pulse it, and we shall see who is awake.

brief_2.text: The Meridian's heart is cold. Three Resonance Cores were scattered when we fell.

brief_3.text: Light in the crystal forest, Motion by the broken engine, Memory on the floating isles. Find them, and I can wake.

brief_why.text: Because the beacon chose you, and I trust the beacon. Also, nobody else answered.

brief_reward.text: Gratitude, a village that does not sink, and possibly a very small hat.

brief_yes.text: Then the valley is in your hands. The mist will part for you once my sensors finish warming up.

after_1.text: The mist still guards the outer zones. My sensors are recalibrating.

after_storm.text: Violet, loud and full of loose energy. It eats a little more of the sky each night.

after_village.text: Wreckhaven was my cargo hold once. Now it has gardens, and I approve.
